Built by people who work on new homes every week.

Where it comes from

Truscale started inside a Dallas-Fort Worth construction trade business that works on new homes for builders every week. We kept seeing the same problems on every lot: takeoffs counted by hand, measurements that did not match the plans, purchase orders released before the permit, and deals that only worked if nothing ran late.

So we built the tool we wanted: one record per project that starts at the plan set and ends at closeout, with the checks a careful project manager would make built in.

How we work

  • Software suggests, people decide. AI reads the plans; an estimator verifies the numbers.
  • Structural results are preliminary. A Texas licensed PE designs and seals the structure.
  • English and Spanish are equal. The crew and the office see the same job in their own language.
  • We never share or sell your information.

Where we are

Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas. We are starting with a private beta for builders, remodelers, investors and developers in North Texas.
